items.item_text: Must possess, upon hire, and maintain a valid CA noncommercial Class C License in accordance with the California (CA) Department of Motor Vehicles.
Background Check: Continued employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory background investigation.
Live Scan Background Check: A Live Scan background check must be completed prior to the start of employment.
Pre-Placement Physical: Employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory physical examination.
Driving Record: The position is subject to the
California DMV "Pull Notice System"
and continued employment is contingent upon proof of a satisfactory driving record.
Color Vision Testing
Ability to stand, stoop, kneel, crouch, push and pull heavy objects up to 50 lbs. (Required)
Other Type of Degree Some Schooling Trade related 6-18 CEU’s
Trade Appropriate Work Hours 2000 trade-appropriate documented work experience hours

Under the general direction of a journey level crafts worker perform routine and semi-skilled maintenance, alterations and repair of campus equipment and/or assist journeyperson with installation and preventive maintenance of HVAC equipment, compressors and auxiliary equipment used in the manufacture and distribution of steam, chilled water, compressed air and distilled water. Assist in the repair of steam lines and vacuum pumps. Operate tools and equipment related to the HVAC trade. Operate and maintain a variety of power and hand tools, transport materials, clean job sites, and observe good safety practices. Maintain logs of completed task.
Working knowledge of general HVAC trade practices and procedures.
Ability to perform routine and semi-skilled tasks assisting Service Engineers or SOE's.
Ability to make minor repairs/installations, or perform preventive maintenance on a variety of University equipment/systems.
Working knowledge of various hand tools, power equipment and supplies of the HVAC trade.
Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations.
Skill in working independently or as part of a work crew follow through on assignments with minimal direction.
Ability to work effectively and productively as part of a team.
Ability to observe all safety practices.
Ability to keep accurate records of work and completed jobs.
